title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
This is not a "9\-to\-5" administrative role. We are looking for a **high\-impact HR Generalist** to spearhead our entire HR department from the ground up. You will be the backbone of our organization, responsible for building a world\-class remote workforce and ensuring our internal engine runs with military precision.

If you are someone who thrives on "quiet days" or waits for instructions, this is not for you. We need a **General**—someone who leads from the front, masters the art of remote hiring, and upholds our company standards without compromise.

**The Mission: What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Remote Talent Hunting:** You will lead the charge in hiring top\-tier technical (Devs, Data) and non\-technical (Sales, Marketing) talent globally. You know where the best remote players hide and how to close them.
* **Department Architecture:** You aren't just "working" in HR; you are **building** it. From onboarding workflows to compliance frameworks, you will design the systems that scale this company.
* **The Compliance Enforcer:** You are the guardian of our rules and regulations. You believe that "punctuality is the soul of business" and ensure every team member operates with the same level of discipline.
* **360\-Degree Communication:** You are a true "people’s person." Whether it’s a difficult conversation with a junior recruit or a strategic pivot with the Founder, you communicate with clarity, empathy, and authority.

**The DNA of Our Ideal Candidate**

* **Obsessed with Results:** You are target\-oriented. A "filled position" isn't a win unless it’s the *right* person at the *right* time.
* **Time\-Agnostic:** You don't look at the clock; you look at the task. You are a **finisher**. If a critical hire or a department emergency requires staying late or stretching overtime, you do it because you take pride in excellence.
* **Expert Recruiter:** You understand the nuances of vetting remote workers—identifying self\-starters, checking for high\-speed connectivity, and assessing cultural fit via Zoom.
* **Disciplined \& Punctual:** To you, "on time" is late. You lead by example and expect the same from everyone else.

**Why This is Your Career\-Defining Move**

* **Full Autonomy:** You will spearhead the HR department. Your fingerprints will be on every hire and every policy.
* **Extreme Growth:** For those willing to learn, this is a masterclass in business scaling and leadership.
* **Impact:** You aren't a cog in a machine; you are the one building the machine.

The Filter: We are looking for a workhorse, not a spectator. If you prioritize "work\-life balance" over "career\-defining results," please do not apply. If you want to be the reason a company doubles in size this year, we want to talk.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹7,000\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* This role requires you to lead and not follow, so you must be an out of the box thinker and a action taker. So, please share your experience where you have met biggest challenge in your HR career and how did you solve it?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Recrutiment: 2 years (Required)
* Sales recruitment: 2 years (Required)
* Education Recruitment: 2 years (Preferred)
* Payroll Management: 1 year (Preferred)
* Employee relations: 1 year (Preferred)
* Compliance management: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Required)
* Hindi (Required)

title: Assistant Manager - Administration
description:
**Mandatory Criteria(Can't be neglected during screening)**

1\. Must have at least 5 years of experience in Office Administration \& Facilities Management  
2\. Must have handled Corporate Travel Management (Domestic \& International) \+ Hotel Bookings  
3\. Must have experience in Vendor Management, Procurement \& Cost Control  
4\. Should have handled Pantry Management \& Housekeeping Staff Supervision  
5\. Should have experience in providing calendar management for leadership team like CEO \& CFO

**Office Administration \& Facilities Management**

* Own end\-to\-end office operations ensuring a clean, safe, organised and employee\-friendly workplace.
* Manage office assets, stationery, supplies and consumables; maintain inventory controls and timely replenishment.
* Coordinate all facility maintenance (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, internet, printers, AMC services, etc.) through vendors.
* Ensure timely resolution of workplace issues raised by employees; track closure through a tracker.
* Drive adherence to workplace policies (visitor management, access control, safety protocols, hygiene standards).
* Coordinate office layout requirements, seating changes, and workspace readiness for new joiners.

**Corporate Travel Management (Domestic \& International) \+ Hotel Bookings**

* Manage end\-to\-end travel arrangements: flight/train bookings, hotel bookings, local transport and itinerary coordination.
* Handle international travel requirements including visa documentation, invitation letters, insurance, forex, and compliance.
* Coordinate with travel partners / portals; ensure cost\-effective options and timely confirmations.
* Maintain travel trackers, reconcile expenses, and ensure policy adherence.
* Support timely reimbursement documentation and closure.

**Vendor Management, Procurement \& Cost Control**

* Identify, onboard and manage vendors for housekeeping, pantry, security, maintenance, courier, cab, hotels, etc.
* Negotiate commercial terms, renewals and AMCs to ensure best value and service levels.
* Maintain vendor database, contracts, invoices, SLAs and performance scorecards.
* Raise POs / approvals as per internal process and coordinate timely payments with Finance.
* Track monthly administrative spends vs budget and highlight variances with corrective actions.

**Pantry Management \& Housekeeping Staff Supervision**

* Manage pantry operations including vendor coordination, supplies, hygiene and service standards.
* Supervise housekeeping staff / agency; define daily checklists and ensure consistent cleanliness standards.
* Ensure meeting rooms, workstations and common areas are maintained at all times.
* Coordinate periodic deep cleaning, pest control and hygiene audits

**Office Events \& Employee Experience Support**

* Plan and execute office events such as townhalls, celebrations, leadership visits, workshops, and engagement activities.
* Coordinate logistics including venue setup, catering, gifts, vendor arrangements and on\-day execution.
* Support corporate gifting requirements for leadership, employee milestones and business needs.

**Front Desk, Courier \& Visitor Management**

* Manage visitor handling ensuring a professional welcome experience and adherence to access and security protocols.
* Handle incoming/outgoing couriers (domestic \& international), tracking, and customs documentation (where required).
* Maintain courier registers and ensure confidentiality of sensitive shipments.

**Select HR Operations Support (as required)**

* Support People team with operational HR tasks such as onboarding logistics, ID cards/access, background verification coordination, joining kits and policy sign\-offs.
* Assist with HR documentation, vendor coordination (medical, insurance, training, etc.) and employee helpdesk support.
* Support coordination for HR calendars (training sessions, inductions, engagement initiatives) and follow\-ups.

**Governance, Reporting \& Process Improvement**

* Build and maintain admin trackers: vendor SLAs, housekeeping checklist, pantry supplies, travel logs, inventory and expense tracker.
* Review processes periodically and propose improvements to reduce cost, improve employee experience and strengthen controls.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional conduct while handling sensitive information.

**Provide calendar management for CEO \& CFO**

* Manages complex calendars, schedule and prioritize meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements for the CEO and CFO
* Manage conflicting schedules and adjust plans as necessary

**Handling Critical Communications**

* Act as a liaison between the CEO, CFO, and other departments within the organization
* Coordinate and communicate with the international team for various things such as events, travel, calendar management, and other matters
* Respond to phone and email inquiries with professionalism and discretion
* Handle sensitive information and maintain confidentiality at all times
* Draft and distribute corporate communications as necessary

7\+ years of experience in Office Administration, Facilities Management, Travel Managenment, etc.

Monitor cloud infrastructure performance and troubleshoot deployment issues.

Basic understanding of Cloud Computing concepts.

Basic knowledge of Docker containers.

Understanding of CI/CD concepts and automation pipelines.

Familiarity with Git version control.

Cloud Computing

Or a related field.

Hands\-on experience with Amazon Web Services cloud infrastructure

Job Description
he Talent Acquisition \& HR Strategic Initiatives role is a key position responsible for driving campus hiring, supporting ongoing lateral recruitment, and managing several organizational programs and HR operations. The role demands a combination of operational efficiency, strong coordination skills, relationship management, and the ability to support strategic HR projects. This position not only focuses on hiring but also significantly contributes to digital initiatives, partnerships, audits, MIS, social media branding, and cross\-functional collaboration to strengthen the overall HR ecosystem.


A major part of the role involves **Campus Hiring Coordination**, which includes planning and driving end?to?end campus recruitment activities across various educational institutions. This involves establishing strong relationships with placement officers, faculty coordinators, and student representatives to build a robust talent pipeline for the organization. The individual must ensure seamless execution of all campus?related processes, including pre?placement talks, assessments, interviews, result communication, offer rollouts, and joining formalities. An important responsibility is evaluating campus performance, analyzing historical data, and recommending improvements to enhance the quality of hires and campus engagement. Along with this, the role also involves handling logistics, travel coordination (if required), and ensuring alignment between academic institutions and internal stakeholders.


In addition to campus hiring, the role requires managing **Digital Initiatives** within the hiring and HR ecosystem. This includes supporting various technology?driven projects aimed at improving recruitment efficiency, reducing manual work, and increasing transparency in hiring processes. The individual collaborates with internal teams such as IT and HR Systems to implement hiring tools, applicant tracking systems, automation workflows, and dashboards. Digital initiatives may also involve designing forms, improving candidate communication channels, implementing innovative sourcing tools, and enhancing the digital hiring experience for a wider audience. The focus is on enabling digital transformation in HR and aligning recruitment processes with evolving business needs.


Another crucial component of the role is managing and expanding **Strategic Partnerships**. The individual acts as a representative of the organization in external forums, establishing partnerships with colleges, skill development institutions, training academies, and industry networks. These partnerships help strengthen the company’s talent pipeline, brand presence, and long?term workforce planning. The role includes evaluating potential partnerships, coordinating MOUs, engaging with external stakeholders, and representing the organization at job fairs, summits, and student interactions. Strong interpersonal and networking abilities are essential to build credibility and maintain productive collaborations.


In terms of reporting and internal monitoring, the individual is responsible for **MIS \& Reporting**, ensuring that recruitment data is accurately recorded, maintained, and analyzed. This includes generating dashboards, tracking recruitment metrics, monitoring hiring funnels, and highlighting gaps or opportunities to improve recruitment performance. The role requires proficiency in Excel or data tools to prepare periodic reports for leadership reviews. MIS insights help stakeholders understand hiring trends, workforce readiness, and the performance of various hiring channels including campus, lateral, internships, and referrals.


Compliance plays a significant role in HR operations, and therefore, the individual supports **Audit \& Compliance Activities**. This includes maintaining documentation required for audits, ensuring recruitment processes adhere to company guidelines, preparing records for internal or external audit teams, and identifying compliance gaps. Understanding hiring policies, background verification protocols, and documentation requirements is essential to maintain organizational integrity and ensure audit preparedness throughout the year.


The position also contributes to brand building through **Social Media Representation**. This involves coordinating with employer branding or communications teams to promote hiring activities, achievements, employee stories, and campus events on platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, or internal communication channels. The individual may support content creation, event promotion, and visual storytelling to boost the organization’s visibility among potential candidates. Social media presence enhances the company’s brand value and helps attract quality talent from diverse backgrounds.


Beyond hiring responsibilities, the role frequently contributes to broader **HR Initiatives and Organizational Programs**. This includes supporting cultural programs, engagement events, HR transformation projects, policy rollouts, and capability development activities. The individual may also take part in special committees, initiatives, or innovation projects aligned with HR goals. Strong collaboration, flexibility, and a proactive mindset are required to handle these responsibilities effectively.


A key operational area under this role is **Cross?Functional Support**, where the individual collaborates with departments such as Operations, Admin, Finance, and IT for smooth execution of hiring and onboarding processes. Coordination may involve arranging IT assets, ensuring workspace readiness, handling pre\-onboarding queries, supporting payroll or documentation, and aligning with various stakeholders to meet organizational goals. This cross\-functional engagement ensures new hires have a seamless transition into the organization.


Additionally, the role includes managing **IPT (Internship / Industrial Training Program) Management**. This involves coordinating internship cycles, allotting mentors, tracking intern progress, organizing feedback sessions, and assisting with project submissions. The individual ensures that interns receive a structured and value?adding experience, which may lead to strong potential for future hiring.


The role is also responsible for executing **Parichay (Induction \& Orientation Program)**. This includes preparing induction schedules, coordinating with trainers, organizing sessions, collecting required documents, and ensuring a smooth onboarding experience for new employees. A well?executed induction plays a significant role in shaping employee perception and integrating them into the organizational culture.


A critical component of HR operations managed in this role is **BGV (Background Verification)**. The individual ensures that all new hires undergo verification checks as per company policy. Responsibilities include coordinating with verification vendors, tracking status updates, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring timely closure of BGV cases to maintain compliance.


Lastly, the position supports **Ongoing Lateral Hiring** by coordinating interview schedules, sourcing profiles (if required), screening candidates, and maintaining pipelines for critical roles. The individual works closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, provide regular updates, and ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment cycle.

--------------------------------------

**Function:** Supply Chain  

**Location:** Mumbai

**Work Mode:** Hybrid **About General Mills**
General Mills is a global food company with **100\+ brands across 100 countries**, including Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Häagen‑Dazs. Founded in **1866**, the company has a long legacy of innovation and delivering food the world loves.

* Apply **statistical forecasting models** and fine\-tune parameters to align forecasts with market dynamics.

* **3\+ years** of relevant experience in analytics or supply chain
* Strong **data analysis and statistical skills**
* Experience with **data visualization tools** (Tableau / Power BI / Looker)
* Familiarity with **forecasting methods** (Time Series models such as Exponential Smoothing, ARIMA; basic ML techniques)
* Proficiency in **Python / R / SQL / Excel**
* Basic knowledge of **cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure)**
* Understanding of **Supply Chain / CPG / Retail** domain
* Strong **problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills**

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Manager, Technology
description:
**Role description** **Who We Are:**



Cimpress develops cutting\-edge, best\-in\-world software that our mass customization businesses use to create personalized products for over 17 million global customers. Our Mass Customization Platform consists of modular, multi\-tenant services. Our businesses can choose the solutions that work for them, or assemble any custom combination they need. This makes it easier and faster to do things like introduce new products, reach customers and track orders.



**Our Team:**



We’re an engineering team of 200\+ people who develop the technology to power Cimpress’s commerce platform that allow customers to easily navigate, discover and purchase the products that they need. We use a variety of modern technologies like Node, React, NextJS, AWS, and many more to build scalable solutions. Through a mix of Agile principles, technical excellence, and cross\-functional collaboration.



**What You Will Do:**


**People Leadership \& Talent Management**


* **Direct Management:** Act as the direct manager for a team of engineers in India, overseeing their career development, performance reviews, and daily engagement.
* **Team Building:** Independently plan and execute changes to team staffing. This includes identifying skill gaps, defining new roles, and managing the hiring process to ensure the team is sized correctly for company goals.
* **Technical Accountability:** Build a culture of ownership where engineers are accountable for their delivery. You will identify process bottlenecks and proactively clear roadblocks to keep the team moving.


**Technical Delivery \& SDLC Excellence**


* **Process Improvement:** Modernize and maintain the team’s SDLC processes. You ensure the team isn't just "writing code," but building high\-quality systems that prioritize **reliability, scalability, and maintainability.**Champion the adoption of AI\-assisted development tools.
* **Architectural Guidance:** Partner with Architects to ensure the team builds simple, straightforward solutions. You are responsible for reducing technical complexity and ensuring the system architecture is flexible enough for future growth.
* **Hands\-on Oversight:** Contribute to the team’s success by providing high\-level feedback on pull requests and reviewing the overall architecture of new features before they are built.


**Operational Strategy \& Metrics**


* **Efficiency Tracking:** Regularly track, share, and improve team metrics (such as velocity, quality, and deployment health) to build a highly performant and predictable team.
* **Tech Debt Advocacy:** Identify areas of technical debt and perform cost/benefit analyses for resolving them. You will work directly with Product teams to ensure this work is integrated into the roadmap.


**Product \& Stakeholder Partnership**


* **Roadmap Execution:** Partner with Product Managers to define deliverables and refine technical estimates. You are responsible for all resource assignments and ensuring the roadmap is realistic.
* **Risk Communication:** Serve as the primary voice for the team regarding technical concerns, scope changes, and project timelines, ensuring stakeholders have full visibility into delivery risks.


**Your Qualifications:**



At Cimpress, we are striving to hire individuals that add new ideas and perspectives to our teams and enhance our culture. No matter your background or work experience, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you feel that you don’t meet the exact



requirements or have the same qualifications. You might be a great candidate for this or other opportunities.


* 10\+ years of experience engineering full\-stack systems


* 4 \+ years of managing a team across distributed locations.


* Ability to engage in technical discussions, ask the right questions, engage at a helpful level and sniff out suboptimal decisions, and advocate for and teach good ones.


* Exceptional coaching and mentorship skills


* Proven track record of being proactive, moving with purpose and responding to problems efficiently.


* Experience identifying risk and strong ability to assess and address risk when needed


* Strong project management skills with an ability to create and manage roadmaps and track and improve team velocity


**Nice to Have:**


* Curiosity: You are driven to understand our business, product, and technology, and to apply that knowledge to create better outcomes


* Incisiveness: You think clearly and analytically. You fairly and holistically evaluate tradeoffs, and have the intellectual reasoning to get the right answer most of the time.


* Exceptional Recruitment Skills: You are able to paint a compelling vision for engineering, understand candidates' motivations and get them excited about making an impact at Cimpress.


**Why You'll Love Working Here:**



There is a lot to love about working at Cimpress. We are an award winning Remote\-First company. We’re an inclusive community. We’re growing (which means you can too). And to help orient us all in the same direction, we have our Cimpress Behaviors which exemplify the behavioral attributes that make us a culturally strong and high\-performing team.


**About Us:**



Cimpress is the design and marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For over 20 years we’ve been inspired by small businesses, and we work incessantly to deliver solutions to their evolving needs. CimpressCreate, 99designs by Cimpress and CimpressPrint, all under the parent brand Cimpress, represent a full\-service design, digital and print solution, elevating small businesses’ presence in physical and digital spaces and powering them to achieve success. Cimpress is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in\-store, online and on\-the\-go.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion:**



Cimpress exists to help our customers live their dreams. Each dream is unique – and the Cimpress team needs to be as well. We believe in the unique contributions of everyone within a diverse global organization. We are collaborative, inclusive, and innovative. We strive to role model and live an inclusive culture of fairness, respect and belonging for all. And we work together to empower each other, creating a space in which each of us can spark our next great idea.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:**



Cimpress, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.

 **Skills**  

  

**About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

title: People Operations Lead/Specialist
description:
**Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (On\-site/Hybrid)**

**Experience: 4 – 6 Years**

**Reports To: Senior HR Manager**  

  

**About Bark**


Bark is an online services marketplace connecting customers with professionals across over 1,000 categories. Operating in nine countries including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, we're transforming how people find trusted service providers for everything from home improvement to professional services.  

  

Our platform uses cutting\-edge technology to match customers with the right professionals quickly and efficiently. With a global team of over 220 people, we're currently undergoing an exciting transformation: migrating from a lead generation model to a full marketplace platform with subscription based pricing.  

  

As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Bark offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025\) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026\. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.  

  

**About Bark India**


Bark India is the largest operation of Bark outside the UK, with more than 100 staff members. Bark India started operations in December 2022 and currently manages Customer Experience, Sales, Marketing Content, CRM functions for Global Operations.

**About the role**


We are actively seeking a highly process\-driven and meticulous HR Executive to serve as the operational backbone of our Bangalore team. The ideal candidate is not just familiar with HR administration but is a true operational expert who thrives in an environment defined by rigid structure, strict statutory compliance, and absolute data accuracy.


In this role, 80% of your bandwidth will be dedicated to the precision execution of the employee lifecycle. You will act as the custodian of our processes, managing every critical touchpoint—from facilitating seamless, compliant onboarding experiences and maintaining error\-free records to managing complex documentation and ensuring dignified, organized exits. Your primary objective is to ensure that our HR operations are audit\-ready, legally sound, and running with machine\-like efficiency.


The remaining 20% of your time will be focused on the human element, where you will support high\-impact employee engagement initiatives to foster a vibrant and positive workplace culture.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**1\. HR Operations \& Lifecycle Management (80%)**


This is the core of your role. You will act as the custodian of employee data and process integrity.


Onboarding \& Induction:

* Manage the end\-to\-end pre\-boarding and onboarding process.
* Coordinate with IT and Admin teams to ensure asset allocation (laptops, ID cards, workstations) is ready before the joining date.

**HRIS \& Data Management:**

* Maintain the Human Resource Information System (HRIS) with 100% accuracy.
* Update employee records regarding transfers, promotions, and personal details.
* Manage leave and attendance tracking systems, ensuring data is ready for payroll processing.

**Payroll Coordination \& Compliance:**

* Act as the SPOC for payroll inputs (LOP data, new joiner data, exit data, reimbursements).
* Ensure adherence to statutory compliances specific to India and Karnataka (PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, and Shops \& Establishments Act).
* Handle employee queries regarding salary slips, tax proofs, and PFwithdrawals.

**Documentation \& Letters:**

* Draft and issue vital HR letters: Offer Letters, Appointment Letters, Appraisal Letters, PIP notifications, and Relieving Letters.
* Maintain digital and physical personnel files in audit\-ready condition.

**Leave \& Attendance Governance**

* 1\. Monitor attendance anomalies, leave misuse, and ensure compliance with company leave policies.
* 2\. Liaise with managers to resolve attendance discrepancies before payroll.

**Offboarding \& Exits:**

* Manage the resignation workflow and calculate notice period adjustments.
* Coordinate the Full \& Final (FnF) settlement process.
* Conduct operational exit interviews to ensure all company assets are recovered.

**Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution**

* 1\. Act as the first point of contact for employee relations concerns, grievances and redirect them to the appropriate leadership.
* 2\. Provide guidance on minor disputes, discipline issues, or workplace behavioural concerns.
* 3\. Escalate sensitive cases to HR Manager or leadership.

**Global Collaboration \& Integration**

* 1\. Align HR operations with global policies while adapting them for India.
* 2\. Participate in cross\-region HR calls and projects.

 **2\. Employee Engagement \& Culture (20%)**


You will support the broader HR team in keeping the workforce motivated.

* Events: Plan and execute monthly birthday bashes, festival celebrations (Diwali, Christmas, Kannada Rajyotsava, etc.), and team outings.
* Communication: Assist in drafting internal emails, newsletters, and policy change announcements.
* Wellness: Coordinate health camps or wellness webinars for employees.

 **Candidate Requirements**

 **Education \& Experience:**

* Experience: 4 to 6 years of proven experience in HR Operations / HR Generalist roles.
* Education: MBA in HR or a Master’s degree with relevant certification.
* Location: Must be based in or willing to relocate to Bangalore.

**Technical Skills:**

* Excel Proficiency: Strong command of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formatting) is mandatory for reporting and payroll inputs.
* HRIS Knowledge: Hands\-on experience with tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Zoho People, Workday, or SAP SuccessFactors.
* Compliance Knowledge: Solid understanding of Indian Labor Laws and Karnataka state statutory requirements.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* High Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for errors in data entry and documentation.
* Confidentiality: Ability to handle sensitive salary and personal data with discretion.
* Process\-Oriented: Ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) rigorously.

 **Perks and Benefits**

* Flexible working policy with India office located in CBD Bangalore
* Insurances \- Family Floater Mediclaim, Employee Personal Accident and Employee Term Life
* Personal annual L\&D Budgets to spend on your development
* Enhanced Gympass membership for all employees with access to mental health courses and fitness classes
* Fully stocked snacks in pantry, Monthly team lunches, Quarterly All\-site Socials
* Being at the forefront of an industry with new and exciting problems to solve

 **Interview Process**

* 1st Stage – Talent Partner Stage (30 mins)
* 2nd Stage – Hiring Manager Stage (30 mins)
* 3rd Stage \- Technical Task (60 mins)
* 4th Stage \- Values interview (45 mins)

 **Diversity Statement**


At Bark, we are a platform for people, revolutionising the way professionals and individuals connect since 2014\. Our culture is defined by excitement, ambition, and a commitment to raising the bar. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) and are dedicated to embedding these principles into everything we do. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, and our focus is on hiring, retaining and developing a globally diverse workforce that is passionate about excelling our platform and supporting our customers succeed. Be part of our dynamic team, where bold ideas thrive, and create a future worth shouting about.

description:
Company

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world\-leading technologies for high\-efficiency electrolysis plants. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate\-neutrality. thyssenkrupp nucera successfully made an IPO in July and is a member of the SDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since September 2023\. www.thyssenkrupp\-nucera.com

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?



At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting\-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.



Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.


**About TRG Screen**

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission\-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.



TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's largest and most respected private equity firms.

**HR Admin Specialist**



Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a strategic and seasoned **Head of HR** to oversee the entire people function of our jewellery manufacturing factory and wholesale operations. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between factory floor productivity and corporate wholesale excellence. The ideal candidate will balance "boots\-on\-the\-ground" labor management with high\-level organizational strategy to ensure a secure, compliant, and motivated workforce.

* **Specialized Recruitment:** Source and hire skilled artisans (karigars), CAD designers, production managers, and high\-performing wholesale sales executives.
* **Scaling:** Manage seasonal hiring surges to meet production deadlines for wedding seasons and festivals.

* **Regulatory Oversight:** Ensure 100% compliance with local labor laws, factory acts, and health and safety regulations.
* **Conflict Resolution:** Act as a mediator between management and factory workers to maintain a harmonious shop floor.
* **Payroll \& Benefits:** Oversee the timely processing of wages, overtime, and statutory benefits (PF, ESI, etc.).

* **Background Verifications:** Implement rigorous vetting processes for all employees given the high\-value nature of the inventory.
* **Policy Enforcement:** Develop and enforce strict SOPs regarding workplace security, frisking protocols, and metal loss prevention from a behavioral standpoint.

**4\. Performance \& Culture**

* **Incentive Schemes:** Design performance\-linked incentive (PLI) programs for both production workers (wastage reduction) and sales teams (revenue targets).
* **Training:** Coordinate specialized training for safety, precision handling of precious metals, and luxury customer service for the wholesale wing.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:** 8–12 years in HR, with at least 3–5 years in a **manufacturing or industrial environment** (Jewellery industry experience is a massive plus).
* **Education:** MBA in HR or Master’s in Human Resources/Labor Laws.
* **Hard Skills:** Deep knowledge of Labor Laws and Factory Compliance.
* **Soft Skills:** High emotional intelligence, "firm but fair" leadership style, and impeccable integrity.
* **Language:** Fluency in malayalam,english ,hindi is essential to communicate effectively with the factory workforce.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Low Attrition:** Keeping your master craftsmen happy and loyal.
* **Zero Legal Risk:** Ensuring the factory remains compliant with no labor disputes.
* **Efficiency:** A recruitment pipeline that fills roles faster than the production line slows down.

title: Lead HR Business Partner
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
===============


The Lead HR Business Partner (HRBP), reporting to the Sr. Director, HR Business Partner, is a strategic, hands\-on global partner who works closely with senior leaders across regions to drive people strategies that support business objectives in a fast\-paced, evolving environment. This role serves as a trusted advisor to global client groups, partnering extensively with U.S.\-based leaders and HR counterparts to ensure alignment, consistency, and scalability of people programs worldwide. The role is based in the Pune office and requires regular in\-person collaboration, with an expectation of working from the office.


Blending strong business acumen with deep HR expertise, the Lead HRBP influences organizational design, workforce planning, talent strategy, and leadership effectiveness across geographies. This is not a purely strategic or high\-level advisory role. The Lead HRBP is expected to roll up their sleeves, get into the details, and personally drive execution—supporting managers with offboarding, performance processes, employee relations, and change initiatives while ensuring timelines, deliverables, and business commitments are met. Success in this role requires comfort operating across time zones, cultures, and matrixed teams, as well as the ability to manage competing priorities, push for follow\-through, and hold leaders accountable in a dynamic environment.


Bottomline: This role requires a strong executor mindset—someone who is comfortable moving between strategy and day\-to\-day delivery, and who takes ownership for ensuring work gets done, not just advised.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Strategic \& Global HR Partnership**

* Serve as a primary HR advisor to senior leaders across global client groups, including close partnership with U.S.\-based leaders and HR counterparts.
* Influence workforce planning, organizational design, and talent strategies that support both regional and global business priorities.
* Navigate complex, ambiguous business challenges by evaluating multiple variables and proposing pragmatic, scalable people solutions.
* Act as a change agent, leading and supporting global change initiatives through clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and strong execution.
* Partner closely with global HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) to design, adapt, and implement programs that are globally aligned while locally relevant.
* Operate as a hands\-on HR partner, directly supporting the execution of people programs, including performance cycles, offboarding, employee relations actions, workforce changes, and leadership transitions.
* Own execution and follow\-through, driving timelines, deliverables, and leader accountability for people initiatives.
* Ensure consistent, timely execution of HR processes by partnering closely with managers and intervening when progress, quality, or deadlines are at risk.
* Get into the details when needed, including documentation, coordination with HR Operations and Legal, and follow\-through on sensitive or time\-bound actions.
* Balance strategic advisory responsibilities with day\-to\-day execution in a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment.

**Talent Management \& Leadership Development**

* Lead end\-to\-end performance management processes, ensuring consistency, accountability, and alignment across regions.
* Coach and advise people leaders on performance, feedback, development, and leadership effectiveness in diverse cultural contexts.
* Partner with Learning \& Development to identify skill gaps and deliver targeted leadership and capability\-building initiatives.
* Drive succession planning and performance calibrations to ensure readiness for key roles globally.

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted advisor on complex employee relations matters, balancing legal, cultural, and business considerations across geographies.
* Support leaders in navigating sensitive issues with sound judgment, empathy, and a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Lead or support global engagement and retention initiatives informed by data, feedback, and business needs.
* Foster a high\-performance, inclusive culture that supports engagement, accountability, and growth.

**Data\-Driven Decision Making \& Influence**

* Analyze HR and people metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities at both regional and global levels.
* Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations for senior leaders.
* Influence decision\-making through clear, tailored communication with executives, managers, and cross\-functional partners.
* Build credibility and trust through proactive communication, strong follow\-through, and consistency across regions.

**Requirements**
================

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in a senior HR Business Partner role.

Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Buenos Aires, Chicago, Dubuque, Plano, and Pune.

description:
**Job Title: HR Recruiter** 

**Location:** Remote  
**Job Type:** Full\-time \| Permanent

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR Recruiter with expertise in USA recruitment processes, tools, and best practices. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the US job market, hiring laws, and recruitment tools to source and hire top talent efficiently. This role requires a strong ability to source, screen, and place candidates in various industries while ensuring compliance with US employment regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

· Develop and execute effective recruiting strategies to attract top talent in the USA.

· Utilize various **USA\-based recruiting tools and platforms** such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter, Bullhorn, JobDiva, and ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems).

· Source and screen candidates using Boolean searches, job boards, networking, and referrals.

· Conduct interviews to assess candidates’ qualifications, skills, and cultural fit.

· Collaborate with hiring managers to understand job requirements and ensure an efficient hiring process.

· Manage full\-cycle recruitment including job postings, sourcing, screening, scheduling interviews, negotiating offers, and onboarding candidates.

· Ensure compliance with **EEO, OFCCP, and other US labor laws** in the recruitment process.

· Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs.

· Utilize data\-driven recruitment metrics to improve hiring efficiency and effectiveness.

· Stay up to date with trends and changes in the US labor market and hiring practices.

· **Mandatory experience in US recruitment** with knowledge of **US hiring laws and employment regulations**.

· Proficiency in **USA\-based recruitment tools** such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Dice, ZipRecruiter, JobDiva, Bullhorn, or other ATS.

· Strong experience in **full\-cycle recruitment** with proven ability to hire high\-quality candidates.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong sourcing skills using job boards, social media, referrals, and direct sourcing techniques.

· Ability to manage multiple open positions and work in a fast\-paced environment.

· Knowledge of visa and work authorization processes (H1B, OPT, GC, etc.) is a plus.

description:
**City:** Gurugram  

**Department:** Human Resources
**Recruiter:** Kirill FeofilovAt Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.


This role sits within the **Digital Transformation function of the People \& Organization department**. You will play a critical role in shaping and delivering complex global HR technology initiatives by combining deep HR tech expertise, solution architecture, and hands\-on AI innovation. You will act as the **bridge between HR, technology, and AI innovation**, designing scalable HR system architectures and building automation solutions that transform HR service delivery globally



The role combines **solution architecture, AI product thinking, automation engineering, and HR tech strategy.**



This is a permanent role, based in **Gurugram (hybrid model)**, our India hub, covering a global scope.


**About the Role**


* **Automation:** Strong hands\-on experience in Scripting process/task automations of HR workflows using niche technologies like UiPath StudioX, Power Automate, Python, GenAI (Claude, GPT, LLMs). Any API/SFTP integrations and building middleware solutions would be a strong plus
* **Solution Architecture Design:** Analyze HR processes \& system landscape reviews, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable to\-be processes and HR Tech system landscape
* **Tech Evaluation \& Adoption**: Scout emerging HR technology solutions like Gen AI \& automation platforms and build AI agents \& tools to automate HR operations
* **Technical Project Delivery**: Lead delivery of global HR Tech projects with multiple workstreams using Jira and building data\-driven business cases \& risk management frameworks
* **Project Reporting \& Governance:** Maintain BPMN process documentation, embed processes in HR service delivery model, run project governance \& stakeholder bodies, set internal control points \& risk frameworks, compliance and data privacy frameworks as per internal and external regulatory standards


**About You**


* 5\+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, automation, or architecture as a Senior Business Analyst, Solution Architect, or RPA/AI Automation Developer
* Experience designing cloud architecture landscapes (AWS/Azure), integrations (API, SFTP, middleware), and automation data flows
* Proven hands\-on experience with Python, RPA, building AI agents with Gen\-AI platforms (Claude, OpenAI, LangChain, vector databases, etc.) or scripting
* Hands\-on Jira portfolio management, Confluence documentation, BPMN modelling, test strategy design (SIT/UAT)
* University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology, HR Tech, or related field
* Any certifications in architecture, RPA, Automation or project management (PMP / SAFe / Scrum / Six Sigma/UiPath or similar) would be nice to have.
* Hands\-on experience delivering global Workday architecture implementations, system redesigns, or HRIS architecture transformations would be a strong plus


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 30 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning \& Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location,



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: DE&A - Core - Data Engineering - Microsoft SQL Server
description:
Junior Data Engineer / DWH \& Python Developer (Fresher)
  

Job Overview
  

We are seeking an analytical and detail\-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our data team. The ideal candidate will assist in the design, development, and maintenance of our data warehouse solutions and ETL processes, ensuring data integrity and accessibility for business intelligence and analytics. This role requires a strong foundation in Python and SQL, problem\-solving skills, and an eagerness to learn cloud\-based data technologies.


Key Responsibilities
  

Data Pipeline Development: Assist in designing and building data pipelines and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes to move data from various sources into the data warehouse.
  

Database Management: Work with relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and potentially NoSQL databases to manage, store, and retrieve data efficiently.
  

Coding \& Automation: Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented Python code for backend systems, data processing, and task automation.
  

Data Quality \& Testing: Conduct data profiling, cleansing, and testing to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  

Collaboration: Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and other team members to understand data requirements and deliver effective technical solutions.
  

Documentation \& Support: Assist in maintaining technical documentation for data flows, processes, and data models, and provide support for data\-related issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications
  

Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  

Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in core Python programming concepts (data types, control structures, functions, OOP) and SQL for database querying and manipulation.
  

Databases: Basic understanding of database management systems and data warehousing concepts (e.g., star schemas, dimensional modeling).
  

Tools: Familiarity with version control systems, especially Git, and an eagerness to learn ETL tools or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  

Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, attention to detail, and excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have) Skills
  

Exposure to Python data manipulation libraries like Pandas or NumPy.
  

Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka) or cloud\-based data services.

description:

title: DE&A - Core - Data Engineering - Microsoft SQL Server
description:
Junior Data Engineer / DWH \& Python Developer (Fresher)
  

Job Overview
  

We are seeking an analytical and detail\-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our data team. The ideal candidate will assist in the design, development, and maintenance of our data warehouse solutions and ETL processes, ensuring data integrity and accessibility for business intelligence and analytics. This role requires a strong foundation in Python and SQL, problem\-solving skills, and an eagerness to learn cloud\-based data technologies.


Key Responsibilities
  

Data Pipeline Development: Assist in designing and building data pipelines and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes to move data from various sources into the data warehouse.
  

Database Management: Work with relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and potentially NoSQL databases to manage, store, and retrieve data efficiently.
  

Coding \& Automation: Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented Python code for backend systems, data processing, and task automation.
  

Data Quality \& Testing: Conduct data profiling, cleansing, and testing to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  

Collaboration: Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and other team members to understand data requirements and deliver effective technical solutions.
  

Documentation \& Support: Assist in maintaining technical documentation for data flows, processes, and data models, and provide support for data\-related issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications
  

Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  

Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in core Python programming concepts (data types, control structures, functions, OOP) and SQL for database querying and manipulation.
  

Databases: Basic understanding of database management systems and data warehousing concepts (e.g., star schemas, dimensional modeling).
  

Tools: Familiarity with version control systems, especially Git, and an eagerness to learn ETL tools or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  

Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, attention to detail, and excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have) Skills
  

Exposure to Python data manipulation libraries like Pandas or NumPy.
  

Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka) or cloud\-based data services.

TDT is currently managed FlockForge Solutions Private Limited located in Tejaswini Building, Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram.

**Whom are we looking for?**

We are looking for digitally savvy journalists to join our growing technology editorial Team. You will be at the forefront of our effort to connect with even more Drupalers.

**Why you?**

Suppose you’re an engineering graduate stuck up in the wrong place or a journalism and mass communication major tired of the monotony of daily chores. You know, you are an exceptional storyteller who could convince others with your skill. You love to write and enjoy others listening to you. You are curious, ready to engage and describe things with passion. You are looking at a role that allows you to work with our digital media team, including SEO analysts, digital consultants, content strategists, communication specialists, content producers, developers and marketers.

The ideal candidate will be an inquisitive storyteller, an avid reader and a follower of the ever\-changing technology world. With a desire to learn, report, and engage the audience.

**What will your role involve?**

Craft compelling copies on Free and Open Source Digital Experience Platform Drupal, The active community behind the success of Drupal, Celebrate the contributors to Drupal, Showcase the organizations using Drupal, and Conduct interviews with industry experts to publish as articles or as videos. Develop creative ideas and concepts, and collaborate with the team.

**Experience**

Freshers or Cub journalists with less than a year of experience.

**Remuneration**

Rs 15,000/month during probation (3 months) and Rs 20,000/month after the probation period.

**Requirements**

* Degree/PG Diploma in Journalism \& Mass Communication preferably with a Science background or a Bachelor Degree in any of the Technology Domains with a firm footing in the English Language. Dropouts could also apply if they have the required language skills.
* Communication, Writing and Copy Editing Skills with an emphasis on English Grammar.
* Desire to keep up pace with a technology crowd rather than the editorial desk of a periodical.
* Essential Skills: New Media Journalism, Reporting, Editing, Analyzing, Interviewing, Podcasting

The requirement is not for a tech journalist but a business journalist focusing on enterprise technology. We are not writing about consumer technology or new\-age gadgets and wearables but will focus on community\-driven initiatives. Our web properties have specific target groups, including local self\-government, government decision\-makers, drupal developers, FOSS enthusiasts, public policy advocates, small and medium businesses, large enterprises and the like. We need to storify these seemingly dry subjects to make them palatable, even for generic readers.

Dare to take up the challenge?

description:
My Design Minds is actively hiring for **Mechanical Design Engineer Jobs** focused on **Scan\-to\-3D CAD conversion, reverse engineering, and production\-ready mechanical design** for industrial and manufacturing clients. This role is critical for executing **international projects**, including on\-site work in **Nigeria**, and therefore demands **strong technical capability, an ownership mindset, and real\-world engineering exposure**.

This is not a desk\-only CAD job. The selected engineer will work on **actual components**, scanned data, manufacturing constraints, and site execution challenges. Candidates must be technically sound, detail\-oriented, and confident in converting raw scan data into accurate, parametric, and manufacturable CAD models.

**Mechanical Design Engineers** will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including tooling, quality, and production to ensure every design meets global manufacturing standards and client specifications. Responsibilities include validating scan accuracy, rebuilding legacy parts, optimizing assemblies for cost\-effective fabrication, and supporting prototype\-to\-production transitions. Strong proficiency in SolidWorks or similar CAD platforms, GD\&T knowledge, and hands\-on understanding of machining or fabrication processes are highly preferred. The role requires communication with international stakeholders, adherence to project timelines, and a proactive approach to solving engineering problems.

Key Responsibilities: Scan to 3D CAD \& Reverse Engineering

* Convert **3D scan data (STL, mesh, point cloud)** into accurate, fully constrained, parametric CAD models
* Understand and work with outputs from **3D scanners** (laser scanners, structured light scanners, handheld scanners)
* Clean, repair, align, and reconstruct scan data for CAD conversion
* Ensure **dimensional accuracy, tolerance control, and feature integrity** during reverse engineering
* Redesign components where required for **improved manufacturability and performance**

3D Modeling \& Engineering Drawings

* Create detailed **3D models** using **SolidWorks and/or Siemens UG\-NX (NX CAD)**
* Develop **2D manufacturing drawings,** including GD\&T, tolerances, surface finish notes, and assembly details
* Prepare drawings suitable for **machining, casting, fabrication, welding, and assembly**
* Support design validation, revisions, and engineering change management

Manufacturing \& Execution Support

* Apply practical knowledge of **manufacturing processes** such as CNC machining, casting, fabrication, sheet metal, and welding
* Coordinate with vendors and workshops to validate design feasibility
* Provide **on\-site technical support** during project execution in Nigeria when required
* Assist in component inspection, measurement verification, and design troubleshooting at client sites

Documentation \& Coordination

* Maintain structured design documentation and version control
* Work closely with project managers, quality teams, vendors, and clients
* Support fast turnaround projects under tight timelines without compromising quality

Mandatory Skills \& Requirements (Non\-Negotiable)

* **3–4 years of hands\-on experience** as a Mechanical Design Engineer
* Strong expertise in **Scan to 3D CAD / Reverse Engineering**
* Advanced working knowledge of **SolidWorks and Siemens UG\-NX**
* Proven ability to create **manufacturing\-ready engineering drawings**
* Good understanding of **3D scanning technologies and workflows**
* Strong fundamentals of **mechanical engineering and manufacturing processes**
* **Valid Passport (Mandatory)**
* Willingness to **travel to Nigeria for project execution** when required
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment

Good to Have (Preferred but Not Mandatory)

* Experience with **heavy engineering, steel plants, mining, or industrial components**
* Exposure to metrology, inspection tools, or quality checks
* Prior experience working on **international or on\-site projects**

Who Should NOT Apply

* Engineers without practical Scan\-to\-CAD experience
* Candidates unwilling to travel internationally
* Freshers or purely academic profiles
* Designers limited to cosmetic or surface\-level 3D modeling

Salary \& Benefits

* **₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month**, depending on technical expertise
* International travel, stay, and project allowances are provided separately
* Opportunity to work on **global industrial projects**

Career Growth

* Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

* Exposure to advanced reverse engineering, scanning technologies, and global clients

description:

description:
**Core Responsibilities**

**1\. Technical QA of Recorded Interviews**

* Reliably watch assigned interview recordings end\-to\-end.

* Exceptional English comprehension with clear and concise written communication skills.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn and the ability to assess professional credentials.
* Strong critical thinking skills to differentiate genuine understanding from superficial or memorized responses.
* Ability to recognize jargon\-heavy answers and evaluate the authenticity of a candidate’s knowledge.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

* Exposure to technical interviewing processes.
* Familiarity with AI tools, capabilities, and common misuse patterns.
* Previous experience in fraud detection, risk operations, or compliance review.

**About Firefly Diamonds**

At Firefly Diamonds we’re building India’s most exciting lab\-grown diamond brand. In just 6 months, we’ve scaled from 0 to 6 retail stores across Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad, with a rapidly growing omni\-channel presence. We’re a small, fast\-moving team building something iconic—and this role is a rare opportunity to shape that journey from the ground up. Backed by over 60 years of jewellery design and craftsmanship, we’re creating bold, modern designs that are redefining the future of fine jewellery.

**Position Overview:** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced individuals to lead our team as a Store Manager/Assistant Store Manager. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership abilities, excellent organizational skills, and a passion for delivering unparalleled service to our valued customers. As a key member of our management team, the Store Manager will play a pivotal role in driving sales, maximizing profitability, and upholding the reputation of our brand.

**Responsibilities:**

**5\. Product Knowledge and Promotion**

**Qualifications and Other Details:**  
1\. Minimum Educational Qualification should be a Bachelors Degree

8\. Passion for jewellery and a commitment to delivering exceptional quality and service to customers.

description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst (Clinical \- U.S Healthcare)** 




**Exp :5 – 9 Years** 




**Notice Period :Imm – 30 Days** 




**Interview:Face to Face** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




 The EMR Business Analyst plays a critical role in bridging the gap between healthcare operations and technology solutions. This position is responsible for analyzing, documenting, and managing business processes related to Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems. The EMR BA collaborates with stakeholders, including healthcare providers, IT professionals, and administrative staff, to ensure the effective implementation and optimization of EMR systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Elicit and document business requirements from key stakeholders to understand their needs related to EMR functionalities.
 



 Analyze and translate business requirements into technical specifications for EMR system enhancements and implementations.
 



 Conduct thorough analysis of existing business processes related to EMR usage and identify areas for improvement.
 



 Recommend and implement process enhancements to optimize the use of EMR systems and improve overall efficiency.
 



 Collaborate with IT teams to ensure successful implementation and integration of EMR systems.
 



 Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to configure, customize, and deploy EMR solutions according to business requirements.
 



 Work closely with data analysts to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and security of EMR data.
 



 Develop and maintain data mapping and data transformation processes for EMR\-related data.
 



 Develop training materials and provide training sessions for end\-users on EMR system functionalities.
 



 Provide ongoing support to users, troubleshoot issues, and address user concerns related to EMR usage.
 



 Develop and execute test plans to ensure the quality and reliability of EMR system implementations.
 



 Collaborate with testing teams to identify and resolve issues during the testing phase.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 A bachelor's degree in healthcare management, health informatics, business administration, or a related field. Additional certifications in healthcare compliance or informatics are beneficial.
 



 In\-depth understanding of Meaningful Use requirements, CMS regulations, and other healthcare compliance initiatives. Familiarity with EHR systems and health information exchange (HIE) standards.
 



 Proficient in data analysis, reporting, and interpretation. Ability to use analytical software and tools effectively.
 



 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex regulatory concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly.
 



 Proven ability to identify compliance\-related challenges and develop effective solutions.
 



 Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders effectively.
 



 Strong focus on accuracy and precision in compliance analysis and documentation.
 



 Ability to adapt to changing regulatory requirements and healthcare industry trends.

title: HR Executive
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Manufacturing \& Labor)

We are seeking a high\-energy **Talent Acquisition Specialist** with a "boots\-on\-the\-ground" mindset to lead our recruitment efforts for our manufacturing facility. This isn't a typical 9\-to\-5 desk job; you will be the bridge between the local labor market and our production floor.

Your primary mission is to ensure our production lines are fully staffed with reliable, skilled, and general labor personnel to meet our demanding output schedules.

Key Responsibilities

* **High\-Volume Sourcing:** Execute aggressive sourcing strategies to attract general laborers, machine operators, warehouse staff, and skilled trades (welders, mechanics, etc.).
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain a "ready\-to\-work" roster of candidates to minimize downtime caused by turnover or seasonal spikes.
* **Community Networking:** Build relationships with local vocational schools, unemployment offices, and community centers to create a steady stream of local talent.
* **Screening \& Onboarding:** Conduct rapid\-fire phone screens and in\-person interviews. Manage the full onboarding process, including background checks, drug screenings, and safety orientations.
* **Agency Management:** Partner with and oversee external staffing agencies when necessary to fill short\-term labor gaps.
* **Retention Analysis:** Work closely with Floor Managers to understand "why" people stay or leave, providing feedback to leadership to improve workplace culture.

Qualifications \& Skills

* **Experience:** 2\+ years in high\-volume recruitment, ideally within manufacturing, logistics, or construction.
* **The "Hustle":** Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment where priorities shift based on production needs.
* **Communication:** Strong interpersonal skills—you should be as comfortable talking to a CEO as you are talking to a forklift operator.
* **Adaptability:** Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and social media sourcing, but also comfortable with traditional "help wanted" outreach.
* **Knowledge:** Basic understanding of local labor laws, wage standards, and safety requirements.

Why This Role Matters

In manufacturing, the product is only as good as the people making it. You are the gatekeeper of our productivity. Without your ability to find and retain the right labor force, the machines don't run.

Note: This role may require occasional early morning or late evening hours to sync with different shift schedules on the production floor.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

* Diversity networks (Women@BCG, Pride@BCG, AccessAbility@BCG)

* Supporting execution of AP strategy: Partnering with the AP UP Senior Manager to ensure delivery against agreed priorities \- including monitoring progress against priorities at AP and system level (e.g., participation in Leader Action Workshop, roll out of “relaunch” initiatives across systems etc.)

* Supporting regional event planning \& execution: Coordinating logistics for AP\-level webinars (e.g., virtual women conference, pride townhall), in\-person conferences and forums (e.g., AP pride conference). Drafting content such as agenda, panel questions, speaker briefs and event run\-of\-show. Creating cost model for budget. Liaising with speakers, moderators, system teams and operations partners to ensure smooth delivery

They will coordinate and provide oversight to the solution/technical leads of multiple development squads.

  

The Solution Architect will also facilitate cross\-enterprise coordination, ensuring that we accommodate requirements across the business and address system integration needs for solutions. title: Analyst – Forensic Investigations (eDiscovery/Business Conduct)
description:
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  





 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters — to you, to your community, and to the world.
   

  





 Progress starts with you.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Business Conduct Office (BCO) is an integral part of Visa's global legal, ethics and compliance team. BCO provides global oversight for the Visa Code of Business Conduct \& Ethics (the "Code"), Visa's Compliance Hotline and online compliance reporting system, conducts investigations, provides general compliance counsel to various areas of the Visa business, and provides oversight for related policies (such as Conflicts of Interest and Non\-Retaliation).
   

  





 The Analyst will support Visa’s BCO forensics and investigations program, managing key aspects of forensics and eDiscovery workflows including data scoping, acquisition, analysis, and reporting. The role will work closely with BCO investigators, Legal, Cybersecurity, IT, and Employee Relations to provide forensic support on internal investigations globally, while assisting with case management, matter tracking, data analytics, operational reporting, and related special projects.
   

  





 Visa promotes an ethical culture and provides employees and outside partners with safe and confidential channels to report concerns. This position requires proactive day\-to\-day management of the Business Conduct office.
   

  





 This position is an Individual Contributor role.
   

  




* Manage forensic and eDiscovery workflows in close partnership with compliance investigators, Legal, Cybersecurity, IT, and Employee Relations (ER), including data scoping, subject identification, and preparation for forensic review.
* Manage forensic data acquisition and preservation across different data sources, endpoints, mobile devices, and Internet\-based sources.
* Conduct forensic analysis, develop investigative timelines and reports, and present findings to lead investigators. Experience with OSINT tools, Nuix, Magnet Axiom, EnCase, FTK, and Cellebrite is a plus.
* Assist and manage BCO investigations, particularly matters involving key controls and cybersecurity policy violations. Participate in interviews, case management, and oversee matter tracking and documentation.
* Maintain operational dashboards for reporting and support strategic initiatives as required. Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau or similar data visualization tools is a plus.
* Manage forensic tools and platforms, performing regular assessments, updates, and troubleshooting to ensure readiness.
* Manage data exports from cloud platforms and endpoints. Proficiency with Microsoft eDiscovery platform is a plus.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, and Go for automation and security systems integration is a plus.
* Experience with data analytics and Generative AI in legal and compliance, cybersecurity or related functions is a plus.



 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 5 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) in computer science, digital forensics, cybersecurity or other relevant field of study
* Professional certifications, i.e. EnCase Certified Examiner (EnCE), GIAC (GCFE, GCFA, GOSI, GASF), Certified Information Systems Security professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) or other similar credentials is a plus
* Experience managing the forensic and eDiscovery lifecycle from intake, data ingestion, analysis, and summary reports
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent critical and data analytic skills
* Proactive, highly responsive, sensitive to confidentiality concerns, ability to empathize while maintaining professional objectivity, collaborative in close team environment, diplomatic, and flexible in adapting to occasional changes in case priorities
* Ability to work independently and use good judgment while also collaborating frequently with BCO team members and others in Legal/Compliance/People Team


**Additional Information**

 Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:
**Role Overview**

**Requirements \& Skills**

* Organization: Exceptional ability to multitask and manage "to\-do" lists without things falling through the cracks.
