title: Workplace Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description** – Manager (CL\-7\)

**Job Title**: Workplace Service Delivery Manager (CL\-7\)

**Management Level**: CL – 7

**Work Location**: Mumbai

**Must have Skills**: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

**Good to have Skills**: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification

**Department**: Corporate Function

**Job Summary**


Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Integrated Facility management**

* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly/ quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.

**Engineering and Technical Services**

* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety. Leverage tools to improve quality of services, including office meters, sensors and SLA tracking.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

**Statutory Compliance and Risks**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**

* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.

**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.

**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**

* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.

**Team Management**

* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**

* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.

**Projects and Transitions**

* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.

**Professional \& Technical Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word), working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Mumbai offices.

  

**Experience**: Minimum 10 years of military experience with at least 4 \- 5 years of corporate IFM experience for Veterans/ Min 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration for others.

**Educational Qualification**: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full\-time MBA or both would be an added advantage.

* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!

* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**

 Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 46,000 employees.
   

  

**About Jubilant Ingrevia Limited**
***JubilantIngreviaisnowamemberoftheeliteGlobalLighthouseNetwork(GLN) oftheWorldEconomicForum(WEF)***
 Jubilant Ingrevia history goes back to 1978 with the incorporation of VAM Organics Limited, which later became Jubilant Organosys and then Jubilant Life Sciences and now demerged to an independent entity as Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, which is listed in both the stock exchanges of India. Over the years, company has developed global capacities and leadership in chosen business segments.
   

  

 Ingrevia is born out of a union of ‘Ingredients’ and ‘Life’ (‘Vie’ in French). Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is committed to offering high\-quality and innovative life science ingredients to enrich all forms of life.
   

  

 Jubilant Ingrevia, a global integrated Life Science products and Innovative Solutions provider serving, Pharmaceutical, Nutrition, Agrochemical, Consumer and Industrial customers with our customised products and solutions that are innovative, cost\-effective and conforming to excellent quality standards.
   

  

 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited offers a broad portfolio of high\-quality ingredients that find application in a wide range of industries. Jubilant Ingrevia’s portfolio also extends to custom development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical and agrochemical customers on an exclusive basis.
   

  

 Ourbusinessissplitacross3businessverticals,withgloballeadership acrossourkeyproductlines.
   

  

***Speciality Chemicals:***
 The Specialty Chemical business of Jubilant Ingrevia manufactures Pyridine, Picolines and its forward integration derivatives, which finds application in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyes, solvents, metal finishes, fine chemicals, semiconductors etc.
   

  

 We have also launched new platform of Diketene \& its value\-added derivatives for multiple industry use. We are an established ‘partner of choice’ in CDMO, with more investment plans in GMP \& Non\-GMP multi\-product facilities for Pharma, Agro and Semi\-conductor customers.
   

  

***Chemical Intermediates:***
 The Chemical Intermediates business has acetic anhydride and value added anhydrides and aldehydes catering to various industries.
   

  

***Nutrition \& Health Solutions:***
 The Nutrition \& Heath Solutions business unit offers B3 \& Picolinates (Chromium \& Zinc) which are fully backward integrated. Our ingredients find application in animal nutrition, human nutrition, personal care, etc. We provide high\-quality feed \& food additives having application in poultry, dairy, aqua \& pet food industry. In Human Nutrition \& Health Solutions, we offer food ingredients \& premix solutions to nutrition.
   

  

 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is supported by five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in India. We practice world\-class manufacturing processes in our day\-to\-day operations, assuring our customers with unmatched quality and timely delivery of products through innovations and cutting\-edge technology. Transforming Manufacturing for Operational Excellence \& Sustainability with “zero tolerance to any non\-compliance” is the core focus of Jubilant Ingrevia Manufacturing.
   

  

 We have 5 world\-class manufacturing facilities i.e. One in UP at Gajraula, Two in Gujarat at Bharuch and Savli, Two in Maharashtra at Nira and Ambernath.
   

  

***Environment Sustainability***
 The company is committed to environmental sustainability and supports green chemistry by prioritising the use of bio inputs in manufacturing. Jubilant is one of the world’s largest producers of Acetaldehyde from the bio route.
   

  

 Find out more about us at www.jubilantingrevia.com

* Support onboarding, role changes, offboarding, and transitions across APAC markets with a consistent, compliant experience.

* Handle routine, low\-risk workplace matters autonomously when appropriate; escalate medium\- to high\-risk situations with recommended next steps and context.
* Ensure employment matters and outcomes are properly documented, tracked, and closed, supporting governance, audit readiness, and trend analysis.
* Stay current on local statutory and regulatory requirements (e.g., employment contracts, statutory benefits, leave laws, and EOR compliance practices) relevant to HR delivery across the region.


**Reporting, Insights \& Continuous Improvement**
* Produce regular HR reporting including headcount, data quality, inquiry volumes, case trends, and operational KPIs.
* Analyze data to identify risk areas, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process improvements, and partner with Shared Services and HRIS teams to drive enhancements.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of HR Shared Services delivery standards, knowledge management, and workflow design in APAC.

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced HR certifications are a plus.

* Demonstrated experience supporting cross\-border HR operations with an understanding of various local labor practices and compliance requirements across APAC.
* Experience partnering with global HR Shared Services teams, local HR partners, payroll vendors, and Legal.


**Language \& Communication**
* Fluent English (written and verbal); additional language proficiency relevant to APAC markets is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills with sensitivity to multicultural stakeholders and global HR partners.


****Technical \& Analytical Skills****
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred), including data governance, reporting, and audit support.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate HR data into insights for operational and governance purposes.
* Familiarity with case management tools (Service Now preferred), ticketing workflows, and service\-level management concepts common in shared services.

* Practical, solution\-oriented operator who balances autonomy with sound escalation judgment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust across diverse cultures and jurisdictions.
* Organized and detail\-oriented with a strong adherence to compliance and data quality.
* Comfortable navigating complex, matrixed environments and prioritizing across multiple markets with differing statutory requirements.

* Regional influence: Support and shape how HR Shared Services operates across APAC for a public\-facing business.

title: HR Specialist APAC - Mobility
description:
****About The Role:****
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
 11
   

  

****About The Role****
 The
 **Senior HR Specialist – Shared Services (APAC)** 
 is a senior HR professional responsible for supporting and coordinating HR Shared Services operations for a diverse APAC employee population (supporting Headcount of approx. 600\) — including Malaysia, India, Australia, Korea, and EOR jurisdictions such as Hong Kong, Singapore, and Thailand.
   

  

 This role ensures
 **HR data quality, compliance with local employment practices, coordinated escalation of employment matters, and consistent delivery of HR services** 
 across these markets. The position is based in India and collaborates with
 **HR Business Partners, Shared Services, Legal, payroll, and external partners** 
 to provide seamless HR service delivery and risk\-aware governance.
   

  

**S\&P Global** 
 has recently announced the intent to separate our Mobility Segment into a standalone public company.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/mobility.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**HR Shared Services \& Data Governance**
* Ensure accurate HR lifecycle data in the HRIS (e.g., Workday) for all APAC employees and contractors, including statutory requirements in each country.
* Oversee the quality and integrity of HR transactions processed via global shared services, external payroll partners, or vendors.
* Act as a regional escalation point for HR operational issues, data discrepancies, and service quality gaps.
* Maintain up\-to\-date Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), control processes, and knowledge artifacts tailored to APAC requirements and manage the change management.
* Run periodic data audits to check data quality and identify \& fix the process gaps for continuous improvement.


**Employee \& Manager Support**
* Serve as a senior point of contact for employees and people leaders across APAC on HR policy questions, procedural guidance, and HRIS issues.
* Triage employee and manager inquiries to appropriate resolution pathways — shared services execution, HRBP, Legal, or external advisors — with clear expectations and timelines.
* Provide practical guidance for performance management, statutory leave, mobility, and other HR processes in line with local practices and global standards.
* Support onboarding, role changes, offboarding, and transitions across APAC markets with a consistent, compliant experience.


**Employment Matters \& Compliance Coordination**
* Monitor employment\-related matters arising across APAC, ensuring appropriate involvement of HRBPs and Legal where issues involve risk or sensitive concerns.
* Handle routine, low\-risk workplace matters autonomously when appropriate; escalate medium\- to high\-risk situations with recommended next steps and context.
* Ensure employment matters and outcomes are properly documented, tracked, and closed, supporting governance, audit readiness, and trend analysis.
* Stay current on local statutory and regulatory requirements (e.g., employment contracts, statutory benefits, leave laws, and EOR compliance practices) relevant to HR delivery across the region.


**Reporting, Insights \& Continuous Improvement**
* Produce regular HR reporting including headcount, data quality, inquiry volumes, case trends, and operational KPIs.
* Analyze data to identify risk areas, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process improvements, and partner with Shared Services and HRIS teams to drive enhancements.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of HR Shared Services delivery standards, knowledge management, and workflow design in APAC.


****What Makes You a Strong Fit****
**Experience \& Domain Knowledge**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced HR certifications are a plus.
* Typically 8\+ years of progressive experience in HR Shared Services, HR Operations, or regional HR roles supporting multiple countries in APAC.
* Demonstrated experience supporting cross\-border HR operations with an understanding of various local labor practices and compliance requirements across APAC.
* Experience partnering with global HR Shared Services teams, local HR partners, payroll vendors, and Legal.


**Language \& Communication**
* Fluent English (written and verbal); additional language proficiency relevant to APAC markets is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills with sensitivity to multicultural stakeholders and global HR partners.


****Technical \& Analytical Skills****
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred), including data governance, reporting, and audit support.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate HR data into insights for operational and governance purposes.
* Familiarity with case management tools (Service Now preferred), ticketing workflows, and service\-level management concepts common in shared services.


****How You’ll Stand Out****
* Practical, solution\-oriented operator who balances autonomy with sound escalation judgment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust across diverse cultures and jurisdictions.
* Organized and detail\-oriented with a strong adherence to compliance and data quality.
* Comfortable navigating complex, matrixed environments and prioritizing across multiple markets with differing statutory requirements.


****Role Benefits \& Impact****
* Regional influence: Support and shape how HR Shared Services operates across APAC for a public\-facing business.
* Career growth: Broaden HR operational and governance exposure across diverse statutory contexts.
* Deep partnership: Work closely with HR Business Partners, Shared Services, Legal, and global HR functions to drive operational excellence.

title: Sr. Manager/Associate Director, HR Business Partner
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 This role acts as a strategic partner to business leaders, aligning HR strategies with organizational goals. The role focuses on driving talent management, employee engagement, workforce planning, and organizational development initiatives to support business growth.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Sr. Manager/Associate Director, IP\&C Has The Following Responsibilities**
**Strategic Partnership**
* Act as a strategic partner to business leaders, providing insights on workforce planning, organizational design, and talent strategies.
* Drive change management initiatives to support USP 2030 strategy.
* Partner with leadership on diversity, equity, and inclusion strategies to build an inclusive culture.
* Liaison between HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) and business units to ensure seamless delivery of HR services.


**Talent Management**
* Partner with business leaders to identify critical roles and build robust succession pipelines.
* Drive leadership development and capability\-building programs to strengthen organizational bench strength.
* Champion career growth initiatives that enhance employee development and retention.
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to align hiring plans with long\-term business objectives and market trends.


**Employee Engagement \& Culture**
* Partner with leadership to foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration, and innovation across all levels of the organization.
* Leverage employee feedback and engagement analytics to identify trends and drive targeted interventions for improved morale and productivity.
* Champion initiatives that reinforce organizational values and behaviors, ensuring cultural consistency during periods of change or growth.


**Performance Management**
* Partner with managers to drive a culture of continuous feedback and accountability, ensuring clarity on expectations and outcomes.
* Coach leaders on managing performance effectively, including addressing underperformance and recognizing high achievers.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management.
* 10\+ years of HR experience with at least 6 years as HRBP preferably experience working in MNC.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills .
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities .
* Demonstrated capability to drive outcomes through collaboration and persuasion.


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Experience in Organization Development, HR Management, Industrial Relations, or related field is a plus.
* Ability to work in a highly matrix environment.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Yes, two HRBPs.
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

description:
**About This Role**
 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a Network Engineering Associate to join our global network engineering team. This role is built for early\-career talent with a strong interest in enterprise networking, infrastructure, and large\-scale technology environments. At BlackRock, we offer an outstanding opportunity to work in an ambitious environment that values learning and career growth.
   

  

 The associate will work alongside senior engineers to support, operate, and improve campus, datacenter, and WAN network environments. They will build hands\-on experience with enterprise\-grade technologies and operational guidelines.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support the day\-to\-day operation of enterprise network infrastructure, including campus LAN, WAN, and connectivity
* Assist with network monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution under mentorship from senior engineers
* Participate in network changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities following defined change\-management processes
* Help document network builds, configurations, and operational procedures to support audit and compliance requirements
* Work with internal partners (e.g., security, workplace technology, cloud teams) to resolve connectivity or performance issues
* Assist in analyzing network performance data and finding opportunities for stability, automation, and improvement
* Follow established security, risk, and operational controls while accomplishing assigned tasks
* Participate in on\-call or follow\-the\-sun support rotations as part of a distributed team (after onboarding)


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering field
* Strong foundational understanding of networking concepts, including:
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* LAN/WAN fundamentals
* Routing and switching basics
* Familiarity with at least one networking area: Campus networking/Data center networking and Network security fundamentals
* Knowledge of SNMP concepts (polling vs traps; SNMPv2 vs SNMPv3 basics) \& Syslog fundamentals (sources, severity levels, forwarding concepts)
* Network monitoring/observability fundamentals (alerts, dashboards, correlation, noise reduction)
* Ticketing/operations platforms for incident workflows (e.g., ServiceNow ITOM/Event Management concepts)
* Network controller/management platforms exposure (e.g., Cisco Catalyst Center/DNAC concepts)
* Exposure to Wi\-Fi build and operations in high\-density environments
* Basic understanding of ITIL or operational support concepts (incidents, changes, problem management)
* Ability to troubleshoot issues using a structured, logical approach
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a global, collaborative environment


**Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Skills**
* Exposure to enterprise networking technologies (e.g., Cisco, Arista, or equivalent)
* Basic scripting or automation exposure (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar)
* Awareness of network security principles (firewalls, segmentation, access control)
* Internship, academic project, or lab experience related to networking or infrastructure
* Industry certifications (or coursework toward): CCNA or CCNP (or equivalent foundational certification)


 What You’ll Gain
   

  

* Hands\-on experience in a large\-scale, enterprise network environment
* Mentorship from experienced network engineers and architects
* Exposure to global infrastructure, modern network build, and operational excellence practices
* A structured learning path to grow into Network Engineer / Senior Engineer roles
* Experience working in a context that emphasizes stability, auditability, and continual progress


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock \| Twitter: @blackrock \| LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Solutions Engineer, Networking Architecture
description:
**What You'll Do**
 At Cisco, we're redefining how the world connects, secures, and innovates. Your mission is to make technology intuitive and enable our customers and partners to realize their full potential as they evolve in an increasingly digital, cloud\-first world. You will lead the way in helping organizations achieve secure, seamless connectivity, harness the power of data and AI, and accelerate their transformation to drive business outcomes.
   

  

 As a Networking Specialist Solution Engineer, you'll work closely with Cisco Partner Account Executives and Selective Partners in a pre\-sales technical capacity, tackling complex challenges in designing, qualifying, and positioning Cisco's industry\-leading solutions along with enabling our Partner Community on latest Cisco Solutions.
   

  

 With primary focus on Networking Architecture, the role requires you to provide both transactional and consultative selling along with collaborating across teams of Cisco Sellers \& partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Expertise** 
 : Act as trusted advisor to customer and Selective Partners by showcasing expertise in Core Cisco Secure Networking portfolio including but not limited to Routing, Switching, WLAN \& Security technologies.
   

  

**Customer \& Partner Engagement** 
 : Lead the technical sales process, designing and presenting relevant solutions based on identified requirements.
   

  

 Deliver compelling technical presentations, enablement sessions, address complex product inquiries from customers \& partners
   

  

**Pre\-sales Activities** 
 : Tasks like technical presentations, Solution Demos, Bill of Material Creation and providing technical proposals are standard for this position.
   

  

**Services \& Collaboration** 
 : Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, sharing technical insights and best practices to foster ongoing innovation.
   

  

**Continuous Learning** 
 : Commit to continuous learning to stay current with emerging technologies and maintain relevant skill sets to support our customers and business objectives.
   

  

**Who You'll Work With**
 You will be part of Cisco Global Virtual Engineering (GVE) team. GVE is composed of highly motivated, talented, and customer\-centric engineers and architects, focused on supporting Cisco SMB and Mid\-Market Customers, along with providing support for aligned Partners. Although the role is based in Bangalore but may require occasional travel to other Indian Cities to support the business.
   

  

 GVE operates as a global organization, offering the opportunity to build a broad human network beyond your immediate team. The environment celebrates diversity and actively seeks individuals who bring diverse skills to strengthen the team. We foster
   

  

 collaboration, inclusion, and continuous growth, enabling you to develop your skills and contribute meaningfully to Cisco's mission of connecting everything securely and making anything possible.
   

  

 Cisco emphasizes a culture of inclusion and diversity, encouraging employees to bring their whole selves to work and supporting career growth through various roles in engineering, customer experience, sales and more.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are a passionate change\-maker who thrives in complex environments and is dedicated to demonstrating how technology can positively transform communities and businesses. As a trusted technical advisor, you excel at simplifying complex concepts and driving business success for Cisco, our Partners and customers. You quickly create value by identifying customer/Partner needs, delivering impactful demonstrations, and designing tailored solutions that lead to technical wins and outstanding customer experiences. Your technical expertise is complemented by your curiosity and commitment to staying at the forefront of networking trends.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of presales experience in a technical role
* Proven customer\-facing experience in presales or consulting
* Exceptional written, verbal, listening, and presentation skills
* Strong knowledge of Networking products and technologies
* Ability to articulate and differentiate Cisco's Networking Portfolio


**Technical Qualifications**
* Industry Certifications like CCNA, CCNP(Enterprise), CCNP (Wireless).
* Knowledge of Enterprise Routing, Switching and Wireless technology
* Working towards any industry led certification.
* Basic understanding of either of Cisco Collaboration, Security, CAI (Cloud and AI) solutions and/or Network Programmability will be added advantage.


**Language Proficiency**
* English (written and spoken)


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. * English language communication ability

* Ability to work well with others in a team environment, displaying excellent time management skills and the ability to follow direction.
* Able to work at heights or use ladders for continued periods

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Substantial background in large scale datacentre network implementations and support.
* Knowledge of Copper and Fiber Optic testing methodologies.
* Ability to read basic layout drawings and floorplans.
* Industry standard certifications (CompTIA, CITY \& GUILDS Cabling cert or equivalent).
* Previous experience working in a Data Center environment (racking \& stacking gear, cable management).

description:
**Overview**
**Job Title: Software Engineer II**
 Would you like to be part of a team that delivers rich, scalable, and secure networking capabilities for private and hybrid cloud environments? Our team owns the Software Defined Networking (SDN) platform, a key component of Microsoft’s Hybrid Cloud portfolio. Customers deploy our SDN solutions across private and hybrid cloud environments.
   

  

 We are a collaborative and inclusive team that puts customer needs first. As part of the Windows \+ Devices organization, you will influence the Windows Server platform that powers critical workloads worldwide.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will work across a broad spectrum of the SDN stack, spanning user and admin experiences, control plane services, and high‑performance networking datapath components. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand customer and user requirements and independently apply appropriate artificial intelligence tools and practices across the software development lifecycle to improve productivity, quality, and insight.
   

  

 You will create clear test strategies to ensure solution quality, write testable, extensible, and maintainable code, and review code to ensure correct test coverage and adherence to team standards. You will implement debugging tools, tests, logs, and telemetry to validate assumptions and improve observability, while striving for automation wherever possible.
   

  

 Security and reliability are first‑class concerns in this role. You will apply and review coding patterns, security risks, and compliance considerations during design and code reviews, and consistently apply security best practices to achieve hardened, production‑ready networking features. Our SDN solution also plays a key role in Azure Arc, enabling customers to build consistent and manageable hybrid cloud environments through end‑to‑end ownership—from UI and APIs to control plane and datapath.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Uses appropriate artificial intelligence (AI) tools and practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) in a disciplined manner. Takes responsibility for the content of their AI\-generated changes to artifacts, reviewing all changes and applying appropriate tooling and processes with minimal guidance.
* Act as a full‑stack engineer delivering features that light up Azure Arc and hybrid cloud networking scenarios.
* Design and implement features collaboratively in C\#, Go, and web technologies (e.g., Angular‑based UI extensions).
* Design and evolve RESTful APIs that form the SDN management and control surface.
* Build and extend microservices and backend components, including evolving data models where persistent state is required.
* Use modern communication frameworks such as gRPC to exchange data reliably and maintain consistency across distributed systems.
* Design and implement test harnesses to validate correctness, push scale limits, and measure performance and reliability.


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
+ OR equivalent experience.


**Other Requirements:** 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Effective coding, debugging, testing, and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Solid understanding of systems software and/or distributed systems.
* A track record of solid results across multiple ship cycles.
* Effective design and implementation skills using C\#, Java, or C\+\+.
* Experience with networking protocols and architecture is a plus.
* Experience with scripting languages.
* Solid understanding of modern computer architectures found in desktop PCs and servers, including computer networking.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
**Role Overview\-**
 We are seeking a
 **Network \& Security Engineer** 
 with strong hands\-on experience in
 **design, build, and delivery** 
 of enterprise network and security solutions. This role is part of a technical delivery team supporting multiple customer projects across network and security domains, starting with a major mining customer.
   

  

 The role is
 **engineering\-led** 
 , with a strong emphasis on
 **design, implementation, and transformation** 
 . The ideal candidate enjoys working close to the technology, translating design intent into working solutions, and operating across varied project contexts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
* Design, implement, and deliver network and security solutions across enterprise environments.
* Perform engineering\-level design activities, including:
+ High\-level designs (HLDs)
+ Detailed designs (LLDs)
+ Configuration standards and build templates
+ Design validation and technical assurance

* Assess existing network and security implementations, identifying inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Engineer and optimise network security controls, including:
+ Segmentation and zoning models
+ Firewall and access control rulebases
+ Policy structure, naming, and hierarchy

* Execute network and security migrations and transformations, such as:
+ Legacy platform uplift or consolidation
+ Policy re\-design and rulebase clean\-up
+ L3/L4 designs evolving toward application\-aware security models

* Work with enterprise\-scale environments, potentially involving:
+ Multiple sites or regions
+ Large rulebases and complex network topologies

* Produce clear, high\-quality engineering documentation.
* Collaborate closely with:
+ Other network and security engineers
+ Technical leads and solution designers
+ Project managers and delivery teams

* Support multiple project engagements while maintaining consistency and engineering quality.


 ,
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years’ experience in hands\-on network and/or network security engineering roles.
* Strong practical experience with:
+ Enterprise networking (routing, switching, segmentation)
+ Network security technologies (firewalls, policy enforcement, access controls)

* Proven ability to design and implement secure, scalable network solutions.
* Strong understanding of:
+ Zone\-based security models
+ Policy design and rulebase structure
+ Network segmentation principles

* Experience working in project delivery environments, contributing directly to build and implementation activities.
* Comfortable working with existing environments, understanding constraints, and improving them pragmatically.
* Strong technical documentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate designs and configurations.


**Highly Desirable Skills**
* Experience with major network and security vendors (e.g. Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper, etc.).
* Exposure to cloud networking and security, particularly where it intersects with enterprise networks.
* Experience with automation or scripting (e.g. Ansible, Terraform, Python) to support repeatable builds or policy management.
* Experience using migration or assessment tools for network or firewall transformations.
* Relevant network, security, or platform certifications.
* Candidates should be able to join in 30 days or less

 The Business Process Analyst / Technical Writer develops, standardizes, and governs engineering policies and procedures across the organization. This role partners with cross\-functional teams to document clear, auditable processes, maintain process compliance, and support internal and external audits. Acting as the custodian of critical engineering documentation, the role ensures processes are current, accessible, and consistently applied company\-wide.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 8–10 years of experience in technical writing, business analysis, or process management within an engineering or IT environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline
* Strong writing and documentation skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, and formal policies, procedures, and process flows
* Proven experience facilitating cross\-functional discussions to define and document business processes
* Knowledge of process governance, internal controls, and audit support activities
* Ability to independently manage documentation initiatives from planning through publication and ongoing maintenance
* Hands\-on experience with documentation and workflow tools, including Confluence, Microsoft Visio, and Jira


 Job responsibilities
   

  

  

* Develop, maintain, and standardize engineering policies and procedures across the organization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and produce clear, formal documentation.
* Govern and act as custodian for process documentation, ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and periodic review.
* Manage documentation review, approval, and exception tracking processes.
* Support internal and external audits by coordinating responses and consolidating required evidence.
* Perform internal process audits and approve just\-in\-time privileged access requests.


 What we offer
   

  

**Culture of caring.** 
 At GlobalLogic, we prioritize a culture of caring. Across every region and department, at every level, we consistently put people first. From day one, you’ll experience an inclusive culture of acceptance and belonging, where you’ll have the chance to build meaningful connections with collaborative teammates, supportive managers, and compassionate leaders.
   

  

**Learning and development.** 
 We are committed to your continuous learning and development. You’ll learn and grow daily in an environment with many opportunities to try new things, sharpen your skills, and advance your career at GlobalLogic. title: Business Analyst
description:
As Gartner Conferences continues its rapid expansion, we are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Sales Operations Analyst to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role supports the operational needs of our growing sales organization (GES and GCC, formerly Evanta), directly impacting sales effectiveness, productivity, and business growth.
   

  

 This role is a key member of the Sales Operations team, focusing on driving sales effectiveness and improving productivity through recurring performance and operational reporting, process optimization, and data\-driven decision support.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
* Influence Strategy: Play a critical role in shaping sales processes and driving data\-backed decisions.
* Innovative Environment: Collaborate with passionate professionals in a culture that values integrity, growth, and collaboration.
* Career Growth: Gain exposure to executive leadership and cross\-functional teams, with ample opportunities to expand your skills and advance your career.


**Responsibilities:**
* Deliver recurring sales performance and operational reports (pipeline, activities, inventory, bookings forecast, conversion metrics) to drive transparency and accountability across the sales organization.
* Prepare executive\-level analytics and presentation materials for sales leadership, highlighting key performance insights and actionable recommendations.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and IT to streamline end\-to\-end sales processes and implement best\-in\-class operational practices.
* Support the annual quota and compensation planning process along with the continual territory optimization initiatives.
* Validate and analyze large sales and operational data sets to develop KPIs and build dashboards that improve sales performance and drive business growth.
* Respond to ad\-hoc data and reporting requests from sales leadership and business stakeholders, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.
* Document and continuously improve sales operations processes and data quality to drive efficiency and scalability.
* Support the successful transition to Salesforce CRM, including data migration and testing.


**Experience Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred, ideally in analytics, quantitative, finance, or a related discipline.
* 2\+ years of experience in sales operations, business analytics, or a related field.
* Exceptional analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret and visualize complex sales data.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting findings to sales leadership.
* Proficiency in Excel, MS Power Platform (BI, Apps, Automate), and CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred); and managing end\-to\-end analytics projects including requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, and cross\-functional project delivery.
* Demonstrate core values: integrity, collaboration, a growth mindset, and objectivity.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic sales environment and maintain a positive, solutions\-oriented approach to challenges.

 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.

 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

 The Business Analyst (BA) plays a key role in analyzing business processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and developing solutions that align with the company's strategic goals. The BA will work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, document business processes, and translate them into actionable insights and plans. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively across various levels of the organization.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* **Requirements Gathering:**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business needs and gather detailed requirements.
* Conduct interviews, workshops, and surveys to elicit and document business processes and system requirements.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications for technical teams.



  




* **Business Process Analysis:**
* Analyze existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Map and document business workflows, identifying key inputs, outputs, and stakeholders.
* Recommend changes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance.



  




* **Solution Design:**
* Work with technical teams to design solutions that meet business needs and align with overall strategy.
* Develop use cases, user stories, and process models to support solution design and development.
* Assist in the creation of prototypes and mockups to visualize solutions before implementation.

**Data Analysis and Reporting:**

description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Sr. TA Partner Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Support in designing and executing employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice, leveraging digital platforms and recruitment marketing tools.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.


**Additional Roles And Responsibilities Include**
* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* Align and ensure the Headcount report is in alignment with Global HR and Finance teams.
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* Support on designing Recruitment policies and Manuals when required. Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 10 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Nil
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Job Description :


The incumbent will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end process of Group Health Insurance policy issuance and endorsement operations, ensuring accurate premium computation, underwriting compliance, and timely service delivery. The role involves handling complete policy issuance activities including validation of underwriting approval, sum insured structure, age band pricing, family definitions, negotiated rates, loadings, discounts, and applicable taxes. The candidate will ensure that policy schedules, certificates of insurance and related documentation are generated accurately and dispatched within defined turnaround times. Close coordination with underwriting, sales, finance, IT, TPA teams, brokers, corporate HR representatives, bancassurance partners, and agency channels is an integral part of the role.


The position requires managing all types of endorsements such as member additions, deletions, sum insured corrections, member detail corrections, and refund or adjustment cases. The candidate must perform pro\-rata premium calculations for additions and deletions, validate financial impact, apply underwriting loadings where applicable, and ensure proper approval workflow for refund endorsements. Every endorsement request must be verified against policy terms and underwriting guidelines before processing. The role demands strong financial accuracy to avoid revenue leakage and ensure compliance with approved quotation terms.


Data validation and quality control form a critical part of the responsibilities. The candidate will perform detailed data sanity checks including validation of date of birth, age calculation, relationship mapping, duplicate member identification, sum insured verification, gender validation, and premium reconciliation. Maintaining error\-free processing standards and ensuring audit readiness through proper documentation and system updates are key expectations.


The role also involves active stakeholder management. The incumbent will regularly interact with brokers, corporate HR teams, bancassurance and agency partners to clarify policy terms, resolve premium disputes, manage escalations, and provide service updates. Internally, coordination with underwriting, sales, operations, claims, and finance teams is necessary to ensure smooth workflow and adherence to service level agreements.


The candidate will be responsible for monitoring turnaround times for policy issuance and endorsement processing, maintaining daily trackers, managing pending cases, and ensuring adherence to defined service standards. Preparation of MIS reports including issuance volume, endorsement volume, premium variance, productivity reports, and error ratio tracking is also part of the role.

description:
**A bit about us**
------------------


Trek is an awesome place to work, with amazing benefits for all employees. We build only products we love, provide incredible hospitality to our customers, and change the world by getting more people on bikes. When you’re on our team, you’re taken care of, encouraged to learn and grow, and given lots of opportunities to do so. Give us your best, and we’ll give it right back. Sound pretty sweet? Then come join us!

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The HRIS Analyst** is a Workday specialist with a particular expertise in **Workday Payroll configuration and processing**, responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable payroll operations. This role analyzes, implements, and maintains Workday to support HR, Payroll, and operations, with a strong focus on payroll accuracy, tax compliance, absence\-to\-pay integration, and payroll\-related feature adoption. The analyst optimizes system functionality, ensures data integrity, and delivers payroll\-first solutions while balancing operational support with strategic initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday System Management and Support**

* Act as Workday SME, guiding stakeholders/cross\-functional teams on solutions for business issues.
* Maintain system (security, processes, reporting, integrations, data loads); troubleshoot, escalate, manage Jira/HR tickets.
* Balance support (ticketing/ad\-hoc) with projects.
* Deliver proactive training/consultation/knowledge transfer on changes/enhancements/implementations.
* Maintain business process docs, user guides, and update communications.
* Ensure internal controls via audits/compliance checks.

**Feature Release Pre\-Planning and Adoption**

* Participate in biannual release pre\-planning: review notes early, evaluate features, assess strategic fit (priorities, ROI, goals).
* Prioritize/recommend adoptions for efficiencies/relationships/benefits; develop value props for leadership.
* Execute implementations (testing, config, change management, user awareness) for smooth adoption.
* Engage Workday roadmap: attend Rising/user groups, network Community, influence as customer voice.

**Payroll Configuration**

* Configure payroll (earnings codes, deductions, tax integrations) for accurate withholding/compliance/tax ties.
* Support processing: test configs, resolve integrations, guide requirements.

**Absence Management**

* Configure absences/time\-off (accruals, balances, sequencing like pro\-ration/carryover) per policies/laws.
* Optimize workflows for efficiency, self\-service, and payroll/benefits integration.

**Analytics and Reporting**

* Build/run/maintain reports/dashboards for HR/Payroll/business insights to drive strategies/decisions.
* Support compensation via grading profiles/eligibility configs as needed.
* Perform data audits/analysis for accuracy/HCM support.

**Project Management and Process Improvement**

* Serve as business analyst: partner with users, understand needs, leverage Workday solutions.
* Prioritize/manage multiple projects (impact/effort/alignment); develop efficient processes.
* Propose enhancements in strategic meetings for adoption/efficiencies/outcomes.
* Maintain vendor ties (Workday/consultants); track trends/best practices to advocate needs.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s in HR, IT, or related.
* 3\-5\+ years Workday config; prefer payroll (earnings/tax) and absence (calculations/sequencing) expertise.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Deep Workday knowledge (architecture, security, reporting, integrations).
* Proficient in Excel, Workday reports/dashboards; familiar with Community.
* Strong oral/written communication; "client service" mindset, collaborative/non\-adversarial.
* Proven PM/process improvement/analytical skills: prioritize, solve problems, drive change in fast\-paced settings.
* Builds trust/cross\-functional relationships for goals.
* Inquisitive/creative/innovative; urgent on docs/results.
* Handles confidential info discreetly; delivers incredible hospitality.
* Multitasks (support/projects); focuses on deadlines.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About the Role**

We are a growing real estate company based in Mumbai seeking an experienced and proactive HR Manager to take full ownership of all human resource functions. The company is building a custom software portal for HR operations, and the ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all HR activities through it, including hiring, terminations, attendance tracking, performance monitoring, EPF compliance, and increment decisions. This is a solo HR leadership role where you will be the single point of contact for all employee\-related matters, shielding senior leadership from day\-to\-day people issues while building a disciplined, performance\-driven work culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

\- Own end\-to\-end hiring across all departments, especially high\-turnover sales roles. Screen, interview, shortlist, and manage onboarding (documentation, induction, role clarity).

**Employee Lifecycle \& Retention**

\- Handle exits (resignation, exit interviews, knowledge transfer, full \& final). Conduct regular one\-on\-ones and stay interviews to identify flight risks early. Design retention strategies tailored to the challenges of real estate sales.

**Performance Management \& Increments**

\- Track attendance, task completion, and performance via the HR portal. Run quarterly and annual reviews based on portal data. Recommend increments strictly on documented performance, not tenure. Prepare PIPs for underperformers. Set measurable KPIs with department heads.

**Attendance \& Discipline**

\- Monitor tardiness, early departures, and absenteeism through the portal. Enforce punctuality via progressive discipline. Manage leave requests in accordance with company policy and the government holiday calendar.

**Compliance**

\- Maintain all employee records, contracts, and documentation.

**HR Portal \& Technology**

\- Manage all HR operations through the company's custom software portal. Generate performance reports and dashboards for leadership. Coordinate with the dev team on portal improvements.

**Employee Relations**

\- Act as the sole point of contact for all employee grievances and queries, keeping senior management out of routine matters. Mediate conflicts, run team meetings, and use psychological insight to address disengagement.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education:** MBA/PGDM in HR Management. A background in psychology (especially Industrial/Organizational Psychology) is strongly preferred.

**Experience:** 4–7 years as an HR generalist handling independent, end\-to\-end operations. Minimum 2 years in real estate, construction, or a high\-turnover sales\-driven industry. Experience managing 30–150 employees and hiring 5–15\+ roles per month. Hands\-on EPF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, and Maharashtra labour law knowledge.

**Core HR Skills:** Full\-cycle recruitment, performance management \& KPI tracking, compensation benchmarking, attendance \& discipline enforcement, HR software proficiency, data\-driven reporting.

**Behavioral Skills:** Emotional intelligence, conflict resolution, motivational interviewing basics, employee engagement, assertive communication, behavioral observation \& early warning detection, cultural sensitivity for Mumbai's diverse workforce.

**Languages:** English and Hindi (mandatory). Marathi.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

* Have you ever managed an HRIS or HR software (like Zoho People, Keka, Darwinbox, etc.) for attendance and leave tracking?
* What is your notice period?
